structure LogState : Type where
  prev : entryID
  sents : List EntryM
  uents : List EntryM
  committed : w64
  applied : w64
  snap : Option entryID
  inprogress : w64
  applying : w64

  stored : List EntryM

  apmax : w64
  storage : Storage
  ksn : List SnapTrip
  fl : w64
  sip : Bool
  lent : Bool
  sapp : Bool
  aps : Bool
  sat : Bool
  sxt : w64

def prstateOfW64 (st : w64) : Option PRState :=
  if st = W64 0 then some PRState.probe
  else if st = W64 1 then some PRState.replicate else if st = W64 2 then some PRState.snapshot else none

theorem becomeCandidate.proj_outbox [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (id : w64) (s : NState)
    : (becomeCandidate id s).outbox = (resetTo s (s.term + W64 1)).outbox

def progressBecomeReplicate (p : Progress) : Progress :=
  have __src := progressResetState p PRState.replicate;
  { matched := __src.matched, next := p.matched + W64 1, sentCommit := __src.sentCommit, state := __src.state,
    pendingSnapshot := __src.pendingSnapshot, paused := __src.paused, infl := __src.infl, learner := __src.learner }

def Perennial.GMap.imap.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {K : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {V' : Type u_3} [DecidableEq
    K] (f : K → V → Option V') (m : GMap K V) : GMap K V' :=
  { lookup := fun k => (m !! k).bind (f k), finite := ⋯ }

    snap := ls.snap, inprogress := ls.inprogress, applying := ls.applying, unpersisted := ls.unpersisted,
    stored := ls.stored, apsize := ls.apsize, apmax := ls.apmax, storage := ls.storage, ksn := ls.ksn, fl := ls.fl,
    sip := ls.sip, lent := ls.lent, sapp := ls.sapp, aps := ls.aps, sat := ls.sat, sxt := ls.sxt }

theorem toPState_becomeLeader [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (id : w64) (s : NState) (pvs
    : GMap w64 Progress) : toPState (have __src := becomeLeader id s; { term := __src.term, vote :=
    __src.vote, lead := __src.lead, role := __src.role, votes := __src.votes, outbox :=
    __src.outbox, stepfn := __src.stepfn, ticking := __src.ticking, progress := __src.progress, log
    := __src.log, logst := __src.logst, prvals := pvs, prevote := __src.prevote, gh := __src.gh, rd
    := __src.rd, lt := __src.lt, pci := __src.pci, isLearner := __src.isLearner, sdr := __src.sdr,
    cq := __src.cq }) = psendMsgs (pwinState id (toPState s) (prvalsMatch pvs)) [pselfAck id
    (pwinState id (toPState s) (prvalsMatch pvs))]

def MsgTransferLeader : w32 :=
  W32 13

def PrOk (ls : LogState) (p : Progress) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ uint.Z p.next ∧
    uint.Z p.next ≤ uint.Z (logLast ls) + 1 ∧
      uint.Z p.matched ≤ uint.Z (logLast ls) ∧ uint.Z p.pendingSnapshot ≤ uint.Z (logLast ls)

theorem inflightsNew.proj_maxBytes (size maxBytes : w64) : (inflightsNew size maxBytes).maxBytes =
    uint.Z maxBytes

def PRole.ofNat : Nat → PRole :=
  bif n.ble 1 then bif n.ble 0 then PRole.follower else PRole.candidate
  else bif n.ble 2 then PRole.leader else PRole.preCandidate

theorem becomePrecandidate.proj_role [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s : NState) :
    (becomePrecandidate s).role = PRole.preCandidate

theorem PRole.ofNat_ctorIdx (x : PRole) : PRole.ofNat x.ctorIdx = x

def PrOkN (ns : Bool) (ls : LogState) (p : Progress) : Prop :=
  PrOk ls p ∧ (ns = true → PrLo p)

theorem PrOkN.of_off {ls : LogState} {p : Progress} (H : PrOk ls p) : PrOkN false ls p

  ∀ (k : w64) (p' : Progress), pvs !! k = some p' → PrKeptAt old li k p'

def prstateW64 : PRState → w64 :=
  match x✝ with
  | PRState.probe => W64 0
  | PRState.replicate => W64 1
  | PRState.snapshot => W64 2

theorem progressBecomeReplicate.proj_state (p : Progress) : (progressBecomeReplicate p).state =
    (progressResetState p PRState.replicate).state

def mtypeOf (t : w32) : Option MsgType :=
  match uint.Z t with
  | 2 => some MsgType.propose
  | 3 => some MsgType.app
  | 4 => some MsgType.appResp
  | 5 => some MsgType.vote
  | 6 => some MsgType.voteResp
  | 7 => some MsgType.snap
  | 8 => some MsgType.heartbeat
  | 9 => some MsgType.heartbeatResp
  | 15 => some MsgType.readIndex
  | 16 => some MsgType.readIndexResp
  | 17 => some MsgType.preVote
  | 18 => some MsgType.preVoteResp
  | x => none

theorem mtypeOf_MsgVote : mtypeOf MsgVote = some MsgType.vote

def progressSentEntries (p : Progress) (entries bytes : w64) : Progress :=
  match p.state with
  | PRState.replicate =>
    if 0 < sint.Z entries then
      { matched := p.matched, next := p.next + entries, sentCommit := p.sentCommit, state := p.state,
        pendingSnapshot := p.pendingSnapshot, paused := inflightsFull (inflightsAdd p.infl bytes),
        infl := inflightsAdd p.infl bytes, learner := p.learner }
    else
      { matched := p.matched, next := p.next, sentCommit := p.sentCommit, state := p.state,
        pendingSnapshot := p.pendingSnapshot, paused := inflightsFull p.infl, infl := p.infl, learner := p.learner }
  | PRState.probe =>
    if 0 < sint.Z entries then
      { matched := p.matched, next := p.next, sentCommit := p.sentCommit, state := p.state,
        pendingSnapshot := p.pendingSnapshot, paused := true, infl := p.infl, learner := p.learner }
    else p
  | PRState.snapshot => p

def NStateWf [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s : NState) : Prop :=
  s.stepfn = stepFuncOf s.role ∧ s.ticking = true

theorem proleRole_leader (ro : PRole) : proleRole ro = Role.leader ↔ ro = PRole.leader

    ls.sents

theorem sendMsgs.proj_outbox (s : NState) (ms : List Msg) : (sendMsgs s ms).outbox = s.outbox ++ ms

theorem PrOk.sentEntries {ls : LogState} {p : Progress} {entries bytes : w64} (Hnw : LogNoWrap ls)
    (H : PrOk ls p) (He : 0 ≤ sint.Z entries) (Hb : uint.Z p.next + sint.Z entries ≤ uint.Z (logLast
    ls) + 1) : PrOk ls (progressSentEntries p entries bytes)

def progressMaybeDecrTo (p : Progress) (rejected matchHint : w64) : Bool × Progress :=
  if p.state = PRState.replicate then
    if uint.Z rejected ≤ uint.Z p.matched then (false, p)
    else
      have nx := p.matched + W64 1;
      (true,
        { matched := p.matched, next := nx, sentCommit := w64Min p.sentCommit (nx - W64 1), state := p.state,
          pendingSnapshot := p.pendingSnapshot, paused := p.paused, infl := p.infl, learner := p.learner })
  else
    if p.next - W64 1 = rejected then
      have nx := w64Max (w64Min rejected (matchHint + W64 1)) (p.matched + W64 1);
      (true,
        { matched := p.matched, next := nx, sentCommit := w64Min p.sentCommit (nx - W64 1), state := p.state,
          pendingSnapshot := p.pendingSnapshot, paused := false, infl := p.infl, learner := p.learner })
    else (false, p)

    commit).infl = p.infl

    iv.maxBytes'

    GMap w64 Progress) (ms : List Msg) : ReplSends id { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead :=
    s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox, stepfn := s.stepfn, ticking :=
    s.ticking, progress := s.progress, log := s.log, logst := s.logst, prvals := pvs, prevote :=
    s.prevote, gh := s.gh, rd := s.rd, lt := s.lt, pci := s.pci, isLearner := s.isLearner, sdr :=
    s.sdr, cq := s.cq } ms ↔ ReplSends id s ms

    [DecidableEq K] (f : K → V → Option V') (m : GMap K V) (k : K) : GMap.imap f m !! k = (m !!

def toPState (s : NState) : PState :=
  { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := if s.role = PRole.preCandidate then W64 0 else s.lead,
    role := proleRole s.role, votes := if s.role = PRole.preCandidate then ∅ else s.votes, outbox := s.outbox,
    base := s.logst.prev, log := s.logst.sents ++ s.logst.uents, commit := s.logst.committed,
    matched := if s.role = PRole.leader then prvalsMatch s.prvals else ∅,
    rd := if s.role = PRole.leader then s.rd else rdNL s.rd }

    (becomeLeaderPre id s).log = (resetTo s s.term).log

    w64) : (becomeFollower s term lead).lead = lead

def LogNoWrap (ls : LogState) : Prop :=
  uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length + ↑ls.uents.length + 1 < 2 ^ 64

theorem PrOkN.becomeProbe {ns : Bool} {ls : LogState} {p : Progress} (Hnw : LogNoWrap ls) (H : PrOkN
    ns ls p) (Hrep : ns = true → p.state = PRState.replicate) : PrOkN ns ls (progressBecomeProbe p)

    (becomeLeaderLog id s).cq = (becomeLeaderPre id s).cq

    ls.apmax

def ResetPr (id li v : w64) (p : Progress) : Prop :=
  p.next = li + W64 1 ∧ (p.matched = if v = id then li else W64 0) ∧ p.pendingSnapshot = W64 0 ∧ p.state = PRState.probe

theorem PrOk.fields {ls : LogState} {p p' : Progress} (H : PrOk ls p) (hn : p'.next = p.next) (hm :
    p'.matched = p.matched) (hs : uint.Z p'.pendingSnapshot ≤ uint.Z p.pendingSnapshot) : PrOk ls p'

    (H : ResetPr id (logLast ls) v p) (Hli : ns = true → 1 ≤ uint.Z (logLast ls)) : PrOkN ns ls p

def progressBecomeProbe (p : Progress) : Progress :=
  have __src := progressResetState p PRState.probe;
  { matched := __src.matched, next := progressBecomeProbeNext p,
    sentCommit := w64Min p.sentCommit (progressBecomeProbeNext p - W64 1), state := __src.state,
    pendingSnapshot := __src.pendingSnapshot, paused := __src.paused, infl := __src.infl, learner := __src.learner }

theorem logRestore.proj_sxt (ls : LogState) (k : SnapTrip) : (logRestore ls k).sxt = if
    ls.snap.isSome = true ∧ uint.Z ls.applying ≤ uint.Z ls.sxt then ls.sxt else ls.applying

inductive PRState : Type
  | PRState.probe : PRState
  | PRState.replicate : PRState
  | PRState.snapshot : PRState

    rd := s.rd, lt := s.lt, pci := s.pci, isLearner := s.isLearner, sdr := s.sdr, cq := s.cq }

    = p.next) (hm : p'.matched = p.matched) (hst : p'.state = p.state) (hs : uint.Z
    p'.pendingSnapshot ≤ uint.Z p.pendingSnapshot) : PrOkN ns ls p'

  stamp s.term (logLast s.logst) 0 (zero_val EntryM)

theorem toPState_votes [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s : NState) (v : GMap w64 Bool) (Hr
    : s.role ≠ PRole.preCandidate) : toPState { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role
    := s.role, votes := v, outbox := s.outbox, stepfn := s.stepfn, ticking := s.ticking, progress :=
    s.progress, log := s.log, logst := s.logst, prvals := s.prvals, prevote := s.prevote, gh :=
    s.gh, rd := s.rd, lt := s.lt, pci := s.pci, isLearner := s.isLearner, sdr := s.sdr, cq := s.cq }
    = have __src := toPState s; { term := __src.term, vote := __src.vote, lead := __src.lead, role
    := __src.role, votes := v, outbox := __src.outbox, base := __src.base, log := __src.log, commit
    := __src.commit, matched := __src.matched, rd := __src.rd }

def progressBecomeProbeNext (p : Progress) : w64 :=
  if p.state = PRState.snapshot then w64Max (p.matched + W64 1) (p.pendingSnapshot + W64 1) else p.matched + W64 1

theorem logRestore.proj_apmax (ls : LogState) (k : SnapTrip) : (logRestore ls k).apmax = ls.apmax

def PrKeptAt (old : GMap w64 Progress) (li k : w64) (p' : Progress) : Prop :=
  (∃ p,
      old !! k = some p ∧
        p'.matched = p.matched ∧ p'.next = p.next ∧ p'.pendingSnapshot = p.pendingSnapshot ∧ p'.state = p.state) ∨
    p'.matched = W64 0 ∧ uint.Z p'.next = max (uint.Z li) 1 ∧ p'.pendingSnapshot = W64 0 ∧ p'.state = PRState.probe

def logLast (ls : LogState) : w64 :=
  W64 (uint.Z ls.prev.index' + ↑ls.sents.length + ↑ls.uents.length)

    (becomeCandidate id s).role = PRole.candidate

def ReplSends (id : w64) (s : NState) (ms : List Msg) : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : Msg),
    m ∈ ms →
      ReplOk id (toPState s) m ∧
        AppCommitEq (toPState s) m ∧
          (m.ty = MsgType.snap → m.dst ∈ s.progress.domSet) ∧ (m.ty = MsgType.snap → s.gh.ns = false)

theorem PrOk.becomeSnapshot {ls : LogState} {p : Progress} {i : w64} (Hnw : LogNoWrap ls) (H : PrOk
    ls p) (Hi : uint.Z i ≤ uint.Z (logLast ls)) : PrOk ls (progressBecomeSnapshot p i)

    p.next = logLast ls + W64 1) (hm : p.matched = W64 0 ∨ p.matched = logLast ls) (hs :
    p.pendingSnapshot = W64 0) (hst : p.state = PRState.probe) (Hli : ns = true → 1 ≤ uint.Z
    (logLast ls)) : PrOkN ns ls p

def logRestore (ls : LogState) (k : SnapTrip) : LogState :=
  { prev := k.sid, sents := [], uents := [], committed := k.sid.index', applied := ls.applied, snap := some k.sid,
    inprogress := k.sid.index' + W64 1, applying := ls.applying, unpersisted := ls.unpersisted, stored := ls.stored,
    apsize := ls.apsize, apmax := ls.apmax, storage := ls.storage, ksn := ls.ksn ++ [k], fl := ls.fl, lent := ls.lent,
    sxt := if ls.snap.isSome = true ∧ uint.Z ls.applying ≤ uint.Z ls.sxt then ls.sxt else ls.applying }

def absSnapFrom (m : MessageM) (src term : w64) (sv : SnapshotM) (voters : CSLists) : Msg :=
  { ty := MsgType.snap, src := src, dst := m.To', term := term, reject := m.Reject', index := sv.Metadata'.Index',
    logterm := sv.Metadata'.Term', commit := m.Commit', rejecthint := m.RejectHint', entries := [], cl := voters,
    al := sv.Metadata'.ConfState'.AutoLeave', ctx := [] }

theorem isMessage_ctx_intro [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (ty : MsgType) (m : MessageM) (ents :
    List EntryM) (ctx : List w8) (hty : ty ≠ MsgType.heartbeat ∧ ty ≠ MsgType.heartbeatResp) :
    isMessage γ (absMsg ty m ents) ⊢ isMessage γ (absMsg ty m ents ctx)

def nextUnstable (ls : LogState) : List EntryM :=
  List.drop (uint.Z ls.inprogress - logOffset ls).toNat ls.uents

theorem PrvalsOk.of_fields {s s' : NState} (H : PrvalsOk s) (hr : s'.role = s.role) (hp : s'.prvals
    = s.prvals) (hl : s'.logst = s.logst) (hg : s'.gh.ns = s.gh.ns := by rfl) : PrvalsOk s'

def resetTo (s : NState) (term : w64) : NState :=
  have __src := resetTo0 s term;
  { term := __src.term, vote := __src.vote, lead := __src.lead, role := __src.role, votes := __src.votes,
    outbox := __src.outbox, stepfn := __src.stepfn, ticking := __src.ticking, progress := __src.progress,
    log := __src.log, logst := __src.logst, prvals := __src.prvals, prevote := __src.prevote, gh := __src.gh,
    rd :=
      have __src := s.rd;
      { states := __src.states, pend := __src.pend },
    lt := __src.lt, isLearner := __src.isLearner, sdr := __src.sdr, cq := __src.cq }

theorem inflightsReset.proj_bytes (i : Inflights) : (inflightsReset i).bytes = 0

theorem progressBecomeProbe.proj_paused (p : Progress) : (progressBecomeProbe p).paused =
    (progressResetState p PRState.probe).paused

def proleRole : PRole → Role :=
  match x✝ with
  | PRole.follower => Role.follower
  | PRole.preCandidate => Role.follower
  | PRole.candidate => Role.candidate
  | PRole.leader => Role.leader

theorem PrvalsOk.mono_log {s : NState} {ls' : LogState} (H : PrvalsOk s) (Hle : s.role =
    PRole.leader → uint.Z (logLast s.logst) ≤ uint.Z (logLast ls')) : PrvalsOk { term := s.term,
    vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox, stepfn :=
    s.stepfn, ticking := s.ticking, progress := s.progress, log := s.log, logst := ls', prvals :=
    s.prvals, prevote := s.prevote, gh := s.gh, rd := s.rd, lt := s.lt, pci := s.pci, isLearner :=
    s.isLearner, sdr := s.sdr, cq := s.cq }

theorem PrOkN.setPaused {ns : Bool} {ls : LogState} {p : Progress} (H : PrOkN ns ls p) (b : Bool) :
    PrOkN ns ls { matched := p.matched, next := p.next, sentCommit := p.sentCommit, state :=
    p.state, pendingSnapshot := p.pendingSnapshot, paused := b, infl := p.infl, learner := p.learner
    }

def MsgCheckQuorum : w32 :=
  W32 12

def becomeLeader [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (id : w64) (s : NState) : NState :=
  sendMsgs (becomeLeaderLog id s) [selfAck id (becomeLeaderLog id s)]

theorem toPState_votes_nonpre [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s : NState) (Hr : s.role ≠
    PRole.preCandidate) : (toPState s).votes = s.votes

theorem becomeFollower.proj_prevote [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s : NState) (term lead
    : w64) : (becomeFollower s term lead).prevote = (resetTo s term).prevote

theorem becomePrecandidate.proj_sdr [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s : NState) :
    (becomePrecandidate s).sdr = s.sdr

theorem becomeLeaderLog.proj_logst [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (id : w64) (s : NState)
    : (becomeLeaderLog id s).logst = logAppend s.logst [leaderEntry s]

theorem progressSentCommit.proj_state (p : Progress) (commit : w64) : (progressSentCommit p
    commit).state = p.state

def stepFuncOf [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] : PRole → GoFunc :=
  match x✝ with
  | PRole.follower => functions stepFollower []
  | PRole.candidate => functions stepCandidate []
  | PRole.preCandidate => functions stepCandidate []
  | PRole.leader => functions stepLeader []

theorem resetTo.proj_vote (s : NState) (term : w64) : (resetTo s term).vote = (resetTo0 s term).vote

def campaignState [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (id : w64) (s : NState) (pre : Bool)
    (peers : List w64) (cl : List w8 := []) : NState :=
  if pre = true then
    sendMsgs (becomePrecandidate s)
      ([Msg.plain MsgType.preVoteResp id id (s.term + W64 1) false] ++
        List.map (fun dst => prevoteReq id dst (s.term + W64 1) (plogLast s.logst.prev (s.logst.sents ++ s.logst.uents)))
          peers)
  else
    sendMsgs (becomeCandidate id s)
      ([Msg.plain MsgType.voteResp id id (becomeCandidate id s).term false] ++
        List.map
          (fun dst =>
            pvoteReq id dst (becomeCandidate id s).term (plogLast s.logst.prev (s.logst.sents ++ s.logst.uents)) cl)
          peers)

theorem becomeLeaderPre.proj_votes [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (id : w64) (s : NState)
    : (becomeLeaderPre id s).votes = (resetTo s s.term).votes

theorem resetTo.proj_prvals (s : NState) (term : w64) : (resetTo s term).prvals = (resetTo0 s
    term).prvals

theorem becomeFollower.proj_votes [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s : NState) (term lead :
    w64) : (becomeFollower s term lead).votes = (resetTo s term).votes

theorem becomeLeaderLog.proj_lt [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (id : w64) (s : NState) :
    (becomeLeaderLog id s).lt = (becomeLeaderPre id s).lt

theorem logAppend.proj_applied (ls : LogState) (ents : List EntryM) : (logAppend ls ents).applied =
    ls.applied

theorem becomePrecandidate.proj_ticking [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s : NState) :
    (becomePrecandidate s).ticking = true

theorem progressBecomeSnapshot.proj_infl (p : Progress) (snapshoti : w64) : (progressBecomeSnapshot
    p snapshoti).infl = (progressResetState p PRState.snapshot).infl

theorem becomeLeaderPre.proj_lead [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (id : w64) (s : NState) :
    (becomeLeaderPre id s).lead = id

theorem progressBecomeReplicate.proj_sentCommit (p : Progress) : (progressBecomeReplicate
    p).sentCommit = (progressResetState p PRState.replicate).sentCommit

theorem becomeLeaderPre.proj_prvals [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (id : w64) (s : NState)
    : (becomeLeaderPre id s).prvals = (resetTo s s.term).prvals

theorem resetTo.proj_log (s : NState) (term : w64) : (resetTo s term).log = (resetTo0 s term).log

theorem PrOk.maybeDecrTo {ls : LogState} {p : Progress} {rejected matchHint : w64} (Hnw : LogNoWrap
    ls) (H : PrOk ls p) : PrOk ls (progressMaybeDecrTo p rejected matchHint).snd

def PrLo (p : Progress) : Prop :=
  2 ≤ uint.Z p.next ∧ (p.state = PRState.replicate → 1 ≤ uint.Z p.matched) ∧ p.state ≠ PRState.snapshot

theorem PrKeptAt.matchKept {old : GMap w64 Progress} {li k : w64} {p' : Progress} (H : PrKeptAt old
    li k p') : uint.Z p'.matched = 0 ∨ ∃ p, old !! k = some p ∧ p.matched = p'.matched

theorem progressSentCommit.proj_paused (p : Progress) (commit : w64) : (progressSentCommit p
    commit).paused = p.paused

theorem LogNoWrap.logLast {ls : LogState} (H : LogNoWrap ls) : uint.Z (logLast ls) + 1 < 2 ^ 64

theorem mtypeOf_MsgHeartbeat : mtypeOf MsgHeartbeat = some MsgType.heartbeat

def StatePreCandidate : w64 :=
  W64 3

theorem becomeLeaderPre.proj_outbox [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (id : w64) (s : NState)
    : (becomeLeaderPre id s).outbox = (resetTo s s.term).outbox

theorem inflightsNew.proj_bytes (size maxBytes : w64) : (inflightsNew size maxBytes).bytes = 0

theorem becomeLeaderPre.proj_lt [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (id : w64) (s : NState) :
    (becomeLeaderPre id s).lt = (resetTo s s.term).lt

theorem PrvalsOk.insert {s : NState} {pvs : GMap w64 Progress} (H : PrvalsOk { term := s.term, vote
    := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox, stepfn :=
    s.stepfn, ticking := s.ticking, progress := s.progress, log := s.log, logst := s.logst, prvals
    := pvs, prevote := s.prevote, gh := s.gh, rd := s.rd, lt := s.lt, pci := s.pci, isLearner :=
    s.isLearner, sdr := s.sdr, cq := s.cq }) {k : w64} {p' : Progress} (Hp : s.role = PRole.leader →
    PrOkN s.gh.ns s.logst p') : PrvalsOk { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role :=
    s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox, stepfn := s.stepfn, ticking := s.ticking, progress
    := s.progress, log := s.log, logst := s.logst, prvals := <[k := p']>pvs, prevote := s.prevote,
    gh := s.gh, rd := s.rd, lt := s.lt, pci := s.pci, isLearner := s.isLearner, sdr := s.sdr, cq :=
    s.cq }

def progressAbs (pv : tracker.Progress) (i : Inflights) : Option Progress :=
  Option.map
    (fun st =>
      { matched := pv.Match', next := pv.Next', sentCommit := pv.sentCommit', state := st,
        pendingSnapshot := pv.PendingSnapshot', paused := pv.MsgAppFlowPaused', infl := i, learner := pv.IsLearner' })
    (prstateOfW64 pv.State')

theorem PrOk.setPaused {ls : LogState} {p : Progress} (H : PrOk ls p) (b : Bool) : PrOk ls { matched
    := p.matched, next := p.next, sentCommit := p.sentCommit, state := p.state, pendingSnapshot :=
    p.pendingSnapshot, paused := b, infl := p.infl, learner := p.learner }

theorem PrOk.fields0 {ls : LogState} {p p' : Progress} (H : PrOk ls p) (hn : p'.next = p.next) (hm :
    p'.matched = p.matched) (hs : p'.pendingSnapshot = W64 0) : PrOk ls p'

theorem logRestore.proj_ksn (ls : LogState) (k : SnapTrip) : (logRestore ls k).ksn = ls.ksn ++ [k]

theorem progressResetState.proj_next (p : Progress) (st : PRState) : (progressResetState p st).next
    = p.next

def stateW64 : PRole → w64 :=
  match x✝ with
  | PRole.follower => StateFollower
  | PRole.candidate => StateCandidate
  | PRole.leader => StateLeader
  | PRole.preCandidate => StatePreCandidate

theorem becomeLeaderPre.proj_term [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (id : w64) (s : NState) :
    (becomeLeaderPre id s).term = (resetTo s s.term).term

theorem PrKept.prOkN {ns : Bool} {old pvs : GMap w64 Progress} {ls : LogState} (H : PrKept old pvs
    (logLast ls)) (Hold : ∀ (v : w64) (p : Progress), old !! v = some p → PrOkN ns ls p) (Hli : ns =
    true → 2 ≤ uint.Z (logLast ls)) (v : w64) (p : Progress) (Hv : pvs !! v = some p) : PrOkN ns ls
    p

def MsgForgetLeader : w32 :=
  W32 23

def PrvalsOk (s : NState) : Prop :=
  s.role = PRole.leader → ∀ (v : w64) (p : Progress), s.prvals !! v = some p → PrOkN s.gh.ns s.logst p

theorem becomeLeaderPre.proj_progress [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (id : w64) (s :
    NState) : (becomeLeaderPre id s).progress = (resetTo s s.term).progress

theorem becomeLeaderPre.proj_isLearner [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (id : w64) (s :
    NState) : (becomeLeaderPre id s).isLearner = (resetTo s s.term).isLearner

theorem logRestore.proj_stored (ls : LogState) (k : SnapTrip) : (logRestore ls k).stored = ls.stored

theorem PrvalsOk.not_leader {s : NState} (h : s.role ≠ PRole.leader) : PrvalsOk s

theorem progressBecomeProbe.proj_state (p : Progress) : (progressBecomeProbe p).state =
    (progressResetState p PRState.probe).state

theorem sendMsgs.proj_stepfn (s : NState) (ms : List Msg) : (sendMsgs s ms).stepfn = s.stepfn

theorem PrOk.clearSnap {ls : LogState} {p : Progress} (H : PrOk ls p) : PrOk ls { matched :=
    p.matched, next := p.next, sentCommit := p.sentCommit, state := p.state, pendingSnapshot := W64
    0, paused := p.paused, infl := p.infl, learner := p.learner }

theorem resetTo.proj_progress (s : NState) (term : w64) : (resetTo s term).progress = (resetTo0 s
    term).progress

theorem becomeCandidate.proj_prevote [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (id : w64) (s :
    NState) : (becomeCandidate id s).prevote = (resetTo s (s.term + W64 1)).prevote

theorem becomeCandidate.proj_lead [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (id : w64) (s : NState) :
    (becomeCandidate id s).lead = (resetTo s (s.term + W64 1)).lead

theorem PrOk.becomeProbe {ls : LogState} {p : Progress} (Hnw : LogNoWrap ls) (H : PrOk ls p) : PrOk
    ls (progressBecomeProbe p)

def StateLeader : w64 :=
  W64 2

theorem toPState_prvals [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s : NState) (pvs : GMap w64
    Progress) (H : s.role = PRole.leader → prvalsMatch pvs = prvalsMatch s.prvals) : toPState { term
    := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox,
    stepfn := s.stepfn, ticking := s.ticking, progress := s.progress, log := s.log, logst :=
    s.logst, prvals := pvs, prevote := s.prevote, gh := s.gh, rd := s.rd, lt := s.lt, pci := s.pci,
    isLearner := s.isLearner, sdr := s.sdr, cq := s.cq } = toPState s

theorem mtypeOf_MsgSnap : mtypeOf MsgSnap = some MsgType.snap

theorem becomePrecandidate.proj_cq [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s : NState) :
    (becomePrecandidate s).cq = s.cq
